Did you know? Mexico City was built on the site of the Aztec city Tenochtitlan. 🤔
It's the fact that opens the Mexico puzzle in Postcards from Everywhere. We've coloured in AZTEC for you: can you find the other 19?
Also in a Large Print Edition with big 16pt letters.
Find the book on Amazon: link in bio.
